question: Do the two official catalogue records cited by Claude identify the1936 Anuario General de España and an accessible1930–1936 edition with explicit telegraphic-address entries?
basis: Human-requested newly observed Message24 of24 in existing Claude chat. Concrete BNE ID Mise0000039089 and Madrid TITN22628. Claude asserts catalogue holdings but explicitly leaves telegraphic fields, digitisation and relevance unverified.
scope: Only Anuario General de España (Bailly-Baillière-Riera), editions1930–1936.1936 preferred; if an official record exposes more than one accessible edition in that interval select latest. One edition maximum. No nominal BLUME/Oswald search, no commercial/cipher conclusions from metadata.
allocation: Entry records count within the six web requests. After records, only exact links returned by official records may be followed within four remaining requests. No invented endpoints or URLs. A single document download if a directly linked PDF is exposed counts separately as at most one own HTTP request; no download if obviously large/whole multi-volume.
relevance: Catalogues can establish title/holdings only. Read coverage/year/volume if supplied; parenthesised holdings cannot be interpreted without a legend. A scan/text of original pages needed to establish telegraphic fields. At most title/contents/abbreviation and one provincial-commercial page, four total. If inaccessible, stop with catalogue-level lead.
stop: Fifteen minutes or caps; stop earlier on inaccessible editions/no linked original. Each access failure counts and is not retried; the second independently fixed entry record remains admissible. No platform/period/query variants, CAPTCHA solving, browser-security bypass, credential changes, mail, orders, purchases or old-route reopenings.
publication: Raw UI/dialogue/captures/external bodies local. Own checked useful summary may be saved/published after root and independent review. Existing frozen phases and public snapshot unchanged until a separately reviewed addition.
